summary.text: TORSHOV TANNKLINIKK AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2012-02-01. TORSHOV TANNKLINIKK AS is engaged in dental practice (tannlegevirksomhet) and all activities related to this. It was previously named SANDAKER TANNKLINIKK AS until 2015-01-14. Its main industry code is 86.230: dental practice care activities. The register shows 5 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 9 897 789 NOK and the annual result was 1 874 005 NOK; operating income was up from 9 468 784 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 1 691 285 NOK in 2024 to 1 874 005 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 3 460 804 NOK in 2024 to 3 334 809 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is torshovtannklinikk.no. The registered employee count went from 6 on 2025-11-13 to 5 on 2026-07-16. The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-16 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
